description: This file contains unit tests using pytest for CLI commands related to credentials management within the litellm project. It mocks external dependencies and tests various credential operations such as list, create, delete, and get, verifying outputs and error handling.

methods.name: mock_credentials_client(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Fixture that patches the CredentialsManagementClient to use a mock object, enabling controlled testing of CLI commands.

methods.name: cli_runner()
methods.description: Fixture that provides a CliRunner instance for invoking CLI commands during tests.

methods.name: test_alist_credentials_table_format(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Tests listing credentials with default table format, verifying presence of credential names and providers.

methods.name: test_alist_credentials_json_format(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Tests listing credentials with JSON output, verifying correct data serialization.

methods.name: test_acreate_credential_success(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Tests creating a credential with valid JSON info and values, verifying success response and method invocation.

methods.name: test_acreate_credential_invalid_json(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid JSON input during credential creation, expecting an error code and message.

methods.name: test_acreate_credential_http_error(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Simulates HTTP error during credential creation to verify proper error handling and output.

methods.name: test_adelete_credential_success(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of a credential, verifying response and method call.

methods.name: test_adelete_credential_http_error(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Simulates HTTP error during credential deletion to verify error reporting.

methods.name: test_aget_credential_success(cli_runner, mock_credentials_client)
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a credential, verifying output matches mock response.
